thread:
maria: FYI prepping AcmeCorp private deployment — need a final pass on the VPC hardening runbook. Main topics: RBAC delta, KMS integration (customer HSM requested), audit log retention and storage, and network policies. Can we lock this before the canary tomorrow? :eyes:

aj: Quick question — are we planning to use hostNetwork for inference pods to hit lower latency? that will change netpols significantly.

maria: Prefer to avoid hostNetwork. We measured ~5% tail perf hit with strict netpols + eBPF Calico on their test cluster; acceptable. NodePort behind NAT gateway is our plan.

sam: KMS: Acme insists on HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM). We currently support AWS KMS CMKs and GCP CMEK; do we have a documented flow for external HSM-backed keys in private deploy?

indra: We do have a proxy pattern: deploy a minimal kms-proxy in the VPC that exchanges a short-lived service token with control plane. Key material stays in customer HSM; we sign requests with the proxy. Need to document the bootstrap step (IAM role / certs).

maria: Right — add explicit bootstrapping steps in runbook: how the customer creates the key alias, grants the gateway role, and how we rotate service certs. Also call out latency impact for cross-AZ calls to KMS.

devsecure-bot: Automated scan: base-image alpine:3.18 has low-severity CVE-2025-xxxx in openssl. Recommendation: roll to alpine:3.19 or rebuild with patched openssl. See ticket SEC-4721.

sam: noted. I'll queue a base-image rebuild and push canary image tag. ETA ~4h.

aj: For RBAC, I drafted minimal roles. Two changes: 1) separate "private-deploy-admin" vs "private-deploy-ops"; 2) restrict log-read to a separate role that requires manager approval for access >30 days.

maria: Paste the RBAC snippet here pls.

aj: Sure — minimal clusterrolebinding example:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: private-deploy-admin-binding
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: private-deploy-admin
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "redwood:alice@acme.example.com"
```
Notes: private-deploy-admin has no log-export privileges by default.

indra: Also add a mandatory 2-week approval workflow for any member added to the log-read group. We'll enforce via OKTA group sync + SCIM.

maria: Audit logging: default plan is 90 days retention in S3 with lifecycle to 1y cold storage. Acme contract asks for 365 days hot. Needs ops cost sign-off. Sam, can you add S3 lifecycle + encryption details to runbook?

sam: Yep. We'll use SSE-KMS with the customer CMK. S3 bucket policy will restrict put/get to the VPC endpoints and our logging service principal. Example snippet for the VPC endpoint allow: 
```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:*","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::acme-audit-*","Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:sourceVpce":"vpce-0abc12345"}}}]}
```

ops-engineer: NetworkPolicy draft attached in infra repo, but here's the critical egress allowlist we agreed on: KMS endpoints, internal cache (memcached) cluster IPs, Prometheus/OTLP collector, and control-plane healthcheck CIDRs. Deny everything else.

maria: Can you paste the minimal netpol for pods?

ops-engineer: Yup:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: private-deploy-egress-lockdown
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16  # cluster internal
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: infra
      ports:
      - protocol: TCP
        port: 443  # KMS/HTTPS
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 12345  # NAT egress for downloads (limited)
```

aj: We should avoid broad 0.0.0.0/0 rules. If downloads are needed, gate with an internal proxy and only allow proxy IPs.

maria: Good call. Update runbook: require egress via proxy and list proxy IPs.

devsecure-bot: Incident simulation result: when netpols are applied without updating CNI hostEndpoint rules, node metrics exporter lost scrape for 3 mins. Recommendation: add hostEndpoint allow for kubelet-proxy on port 10250 with strict CIDR.

ops-engineer: Will add hostEndpoint entry and validate on staging.

indra: One more: ensure we rotate KMS CMK policy to include our service principal with least privileges and add a visible audit trail for key usage (CloudTrail). Add CloudTrail addressable alerts for unusual decrypt frequency.

maria: Excellent. To summarize action items: 
- Sam: rebuild base image & push canary (SEC ticket linked).
- Ops-engineer: update netpol to proxy-only egress + hostEndpoint for kubelet.
- Aj: final RBAC YAML + OKTA sync steps.
- Indra: KMS bootstrapping steps + CloudTrail alert recipe.
- Maria: update runbook with S3 lifecycle and cost note; coordinate final sign-off.

sam: I'll ping when canary pushed.

ops-engineer: I'll schedule the canary for Tue 00:30 UTC and run the preflight checklist.

maria: Thanks all — if no blockers I will mark runbook ready and notify Acme. :thumbsup:
